detail.longDescription:
The #KDE flack account has fled from me, for obvious reasons, but I'd like to point out that they should NOT have done that. It's not the place for any #tech organization claiming to be a representative body for large numbers of computer users to decide arbitrarily that certain members of the public are too *nasty* or *angry* to deal with--that's an emotional judgment and the KDE flack account should not have placed their own feelings first. But in practice no tech organization actually feels like they have a duty to field criticism from the public, because (as I have been saying) they secretly regard their only true constituency as a narrow elitist slice of "doers" and "makers" and "creators", i.e. #programming geeklords with lots of money and free time to waste on ordering other people around.

~Chara of Pnictogen
